goal: Test whether a mechanism learned on Bonoloto transfers prospectively to Primitiva without target-game tuning, while keeping all previously exposed target history out of fresh validation.

excludedTransfers.detail: Euromillones main-number regime is 5-of-50 plus stars, not 6-of-49. A target-safe deterministic mapping is not frozen yet; executing it inside v315 would require extra design choices and inflate multiplicity.

sourceMechanismArtifact.frozenConfigs: all 12 v138 configurations exactly as frozen; no target-driven config selection is allowed

sourceTrainingWindow.note: Only Bonoloto determined the 12 frozen v138 configuration parameters.

targetHoldoutWindow.note: All Primitiva outcomes available on or before 2026-08-17 are treated as exposed discovery context and cannot count as fresh v315 validation.

transferMapping.sharedSupport: Both Bonoloto and Primitiva main-number spaces are 1..49 and draw 6 main numbers.
transferMapping.procedure: For each Primitiva target draw and each frozen v138 configuration, rebuild the same weighted co-occurrence graph from Primitiva draws strictly before the target timestamp using the unchanged frozen window and sign parameters; rank 1..49 with the unchanged v138 degree/clustering/neighbor-entropy formula; emit exactly the top 6 as one ticket for that configuration.

required: at least max frozen v138 window prior target draws available
regimeCompatibilityTest.failurePolicy: skip the draw before outcome access and persist the incompatibility reason

ticketBudget.note: The experiment evaluates one top-6 line per frozen configuration; it does not expand to a top-8 combination system.

marginalFrequencyBaselineSpec.procedure: Using only Primitiva draws strictly before each target timestamp, rank numbers by trailing marginal frequency with the corresponding frozen v138 window length and emit top 6; no parameter search.

recencyBaselineSpec.procedure: Using only Primitiva draws strictly before each target timestamp, rank numbers by recency since last appearance and emit top 6 under both frozen signs already represented by the source family; no target tuning.

freeze.multiplicityMethod: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise error control at alpha=0.05 across the 12 frozen source configurations
freeze.primaryMetric: paired mean main-number hits per frozen transferred 6-number line versus the matched-cost random baseline, higher is better

inference.promotionGate: A transfer signal requires positive paired effect versus matched-cost random, Holm-adjusted p<0.05 across 12 frozen configurations, positive effect versus both frozen marginal-frequency and recency baselines, at least 200 eligible prospective target draws, and no post-freeze retuning.
inference.extremeEventAudit: Any prospective 5/6, 6/6 or repeat5+ triggers lineage verification, timestamp/seal verification, duplicate-behavior analysis, exact matched-cost null replay and multiplicity correction before interpretation.
inference.realMoneyPolicy: Even a positive v315 result does not authorize real-money play. A later untouched preregistered replication is required.

successGate: Transfer must beat frozen matched-cost random, marginal-frequency and recency baselines on the prospective Primitiva holdout and survive Holm correction.
failureGate: Archive if transfer vanishes prospectively, depends on target tuning, fails regime compatibility, is explained by marginal frequency/recency, or duplicates an already falsified transfer direction.
